packageRules.description: Python is pinned at 3.13: PyIceberg, Polars and DuckDB have no 3.14 support, and all of silver and gold runs on those three. Revisit when they ship 3.14 wheels.
GitHub Actions drift silently and are cheap to verify -- CI either passes or it does not. Group them and let non-major updates merge on their own.

Dev tooling only affects the build, never the data. Group it so one PR carries ruff, pyright, pytest and friends together. The depType spelling for a PEP 735 group has varied across Renovate versions, so match every form rather than depend on one.
ruff is pinned twice -- pyproject.toml and the ruff-pre-commit rev. They must move together or the hook and CI disagree.

Runtime data dependencies get a PR to read, never an automerge. CI does not exercise RustFS or Iceberg -- integration tests are excluded there -- so a green check is not evidence the pipeline still works.
